o.text: Analyzable as əsri- + -k. Cognate with Turkish esrik, Tatar исрек (isrek).
Borrowed from Arabic جَاذِبَة (jāḏiba), feminine of جَاذِب (jāḏib), active participle of جَذَبَ (jaḏaba, “to attract, to captivate”).
